title: Federal Register: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Requirements for Cosmetic Products (OMB 0910-0599, MoCRA)

history.reason: Source read directly on the access date; findings transcribed from the document.

publisher: U.S. Food and Drug Administration (via GovInfo / Federal Register)
source_type: Government information collection notice with burden tables
reliability: Government document; the issuing agency (FDA) is also the party administering the requirement. Figures are FDA ex ante estimates, not measured burden.
findings: FDA estimates total annual recordkeeping/reporting burden of 367,777 hours (417,698 total annual responses) for the cosmetics collection.
Initial facility registration: 8,343 respondents, 1 response each, 0.5 hour per response (4,172 hours); FDA says this is based on "internal trials and communication with industry".

Initial cosmetic product listing: 22,564 respondents averaging 14.64 responses each (330,337 responses) at 1 hour per response, 330,337 hours (about 90% of the 367,777 total). Listing renewals: 25,190 respondents, 0.10 hour each (2,519 hours); listing updates: 3,020 respondents, 8.15 responses, 0.25 hour (6,153 hours).

Safety substantiation recordkeeping (sec. 608(a)): 22,564 respondents, one record each, 1 hour, 22,564 hours; FDA says responsible persons have discretion in which records satisfy the requirement and it assumes at least one record each.

Adverse event recordkeeping (sec. 605(e)(1)): 1,165 respondents, 1.2 responses, 0.6 hour (839 hours); records kept six years, three years for qualifying small businesses. FDA says the cosmetics-only count may be lower than shown because the underlying data combine cosmetics, food and infant formula reports.
Third-party disclosure (labeling) table: 676,170 annual disclosures; for example 5,738 respondents averaging about 21-24 labels each.

FDA states there are no capital or operating and maintenance costs, and that two comments received on the July 17, 2026 60-day notice did not discuss the collection topics or suggest revising the figures.
limitations: Notice contains no dollar cost estimate and no breakdown by firm size; the small-business share of respondents is not stated.
Hour estimates are FDA assumptions; no measured time or consultant spend. FDA notes the respondent counts may overstate unique respondents.

The October notice cites the July notice as 91 FR 9287, whereas the July notice (FDA-2026-N-6739) appears at page 44850 of the July 17, 2026 issue; the 60-day notice itself (doc 2026-14434) was not recorded as a separate source.

Table 1 text was extracted from PDF columns; row-to-value alignment was cross-checked against the July notice and the arithmetic (responses x hours) but not against the FDA web page for OMB 0910-0599.
OMB approval status after this submission was not checked.
